Senior AI-Augmented Full Stack Developer
SureSwift Capital Victoria, Canada

Job Title

Senior AI-Augmented Full Stack Developer

Job Description

About SureSwift Capital SureSwift Capital is a private equity firm with a diversified digital portfolio, seeking a seasoned, front-end-leaning full-stack developer to build and modernize software across a portfolio of SaaS businesses. Our focus is transformation via AI enablement, and this role sits at the center of it: someone who thinks differently about how software gets built, leveraging AI as a core part of their workflow, not just a tool.

About the Role The successful candidate will work across different web technology stacks as a true generalist, ramping quickly in unfamiliar environments and using AI to accelerate development, reduce friction, and ship high-quality features faster. They will own feature development end-to-end while maintaining the stability and performance of existing production systems. This role works closely with the cross-functional team and reports to the Portfolio Leader (or designate).

The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable extending legacy production applications and shipping polished new features, with a genuine eye for how software looks and feels to the user.

What You’ll Do

Feature Development & Delivery

  • Own feature development end-to-end, from UI design through backend implementation, QA, and deployment.
  • Partner with the Portfolio Leader and business teams to prioritize and deliver features for existing applications.
  • Build new features, fix bugs, and optimize performance across diverse tech stacks.
  • Set and uphold a high bar for how things look and feel to the user.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Develop repeatable approaches and best practices for AI-assisted development.
  • Own AI as a core part of the development workflow to accelerate delivery and reduce friction.
  • Apply and champion AI-powered code generation and agentic tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) throughout the build process.

Legacy Systems & Code Quality

  • Take ownership of understanding and extending legacy production systems while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Drive modernization of existing applications without disrupting customers.
  • Establish robust test coverage, regression checks, and safe deployment workflows.

What We Offer

  • Flexible scheduling, focus on deliverables
  • Extended health and dental benefits from day one
  • Annual salary $140,000- $190,000 CDN

We are a remote company and are filling this role in Canada. We have office space and hybrid work available for candidates located in Victoria, BC. We thank everyone for their consideration.

Restrictions

  • No telecommuting
  • No Agencies Please

Requirements

What You Bring

Required - Demonstrated experience with modern AI coding tools (especially agentic solutions like Claude Code) as a core part of the workflow.

  • Product-First AI Mindset: Focus on business value, user experience, and applying use of development via models directly to solve practical end-user challenges.
  • Experience modernizing and extending existing legacy production applications while maintaining stability.
  • Proven track record of technically leading engineering workstreams, taking ownership of the development lifecycle, and mentoring junior-to-mid level developers.
  • Proven history of delivering high-quality, maintainable software within production environments, emphasizing robust testing, rigorous security auditing, and proactive dependency management.
  • Experience with modern frontend and backend technologies, including PHP, CodeIgniter, MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Docker, and AWS.
  • UI/UX design sensibility or formal design experience.
  • Ability to communicate with executive leadership effectively on project status.

Contact Info

  • Contact: REDACTED
  • E-mail contact: REDACTED
  • Web: https://sureswiftcapital.applytojob.com/apply/9mhBaI2XKa/Senior-AIAugmented-Full-Stack-Developer?source=python
